# heraut commit tickets

Show the tickets your commits.tickets patterns find in a range of commits.

Show which ticket references the commits.tickets patterns of .heraut.yml find in a range of
commits, and the link each one becomes in the changelog. A diagnostic for writing those patterns: it
warns when nothing matches but never fails.

## Usage

```text
heraut commit tickets [rev-range] [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
heraut commit tickets --from-latest-tag
heraut commit tickets v1.2.0..HEAD
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--env <string>` |  | target environment (for per-env strategies) |
| `--from-latest-tag` |  | check commits since the latest tag (mutually exclusive with rev-range) |

## Global flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--config <string>` |  | path to .heraut.yml (default: auto-discover) |
| `--verbose` |  | echo each command and emit diagnostic logs |
